d:
Israil men chunav ke karib char haphte bad naee sarkar ke gathan ki koshishen tej ho gaee hain. gadi aaizenkot ke netritv men vipakshi dal binyamin netanyahu ke lanbe shasan ko khatm karne ki ranniti bana rahe hain. haredi partiyon, arab sansdon aur dharmanirpeksh dalon ke bich gathbandhan ko lekar batchit jari hai, lekin kaee muddon par matbhed bhi hain. aise men saval hai ki kya aaizenkot naee sarkar bana paenge? kya netanyahu ki siyasat ka ant karib hai ya ve ek bar phir satta bachane men kamyab honge?
Riport: muhannad tutunji
Aavaz: prabhat kumar pandey
Vidiyo editar: sumit vaid
